fullPassage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine decision-making authority ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.

det.analysis: 본문 S4 'with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes'에서 작업자들이 더 적게 저지른 것은 mistakes이며, 그 표현은 fewer mistakes(더 적은 실수)이다.
det.tip: making fewer mistakes = 더 적은 실수를 저지르다

questions.passage: Productivity increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and __________ (make) fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: with + 명사 + V-ing 구문에서 taking과 병렬된 현재분사 → making
det.analysis: 'with + 명사 + 분사' 부대상황 구문에서 앞의 taking과 and로 병렬되는 현재분사가 필요하다. make → making. taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes = 더 짧은 휴식을 취하고 더 적은 실수를 하면서.
det.tip: with workers taking ... and making ~ (분사 병렬)

questions.passage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine decision-making authority ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. They designed their own uniforms and had authority over shifts while all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same. Within two months, productivity at the plant increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 직원에게 주인의식(통제감)을 주면 생산성과 자기 통제력이 향상됨을 설명
det.analysis:
❌ ① 공장 자동화: 본문은 자동화가 아닌 주인의식을 다룸

❌ ② 임금 인상: 본문은 임금이 그대로였다고 함 — 반대

❌ ③ 안전 규정: 본문과 무관

✅ ④ 주인의식 부여 시 생산성·자기 통제력 향상: 본문 전체가 주인의식의 긍정적 효과를 설명 ←정답
det.tip: a sense of agency → productivity + self-discipline 향상

ch: 임금 인상이 직원 만족도를 높이는 과정
직원에게 주인의식을 부여할 때 나타나는 생산성과 자기 통제력의 향상

questions.passage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine decision-making authority ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. They designed their own uniforms and had authority over shifts while all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same. Within two months, productivity at the plant increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 통제감을 주면 임금 인상 없이도 생산성과 자기 통제력이 향상된다
det.analysis:
✅ ① 통제감 → 임금 인상 없이 생산성·자기 통제력 향상: 본문 S1~S5의 핵심과 일치 ←정답

❌ ② 반드시 임금 인상: 본문은 임금이 그대로였다고 함 — 반대

❌ ③ 작업 환경 변경이 부정적: 본문은 긍정적 효과를 서술 — 반대

❌ ④ 권한 주면 실수 늘어남: 본문 S4는 실수가 줄었다고 함 — 반대
det.tip: pay stayed the same, yet productivity and self-discipline improved

ch: 직원에게 통제감(주인의식)을 주면 급여를 올리지 않아도 생산성과 자기 통제력이 향상된다.
생산성을 높이려면 반드시 임금을 인상해야 한다.
작업 환경을 바꾸는 것은 생산성에 부정적 영향을 준다.
직원에게 권한을 주면 실수가 늘어나 생산성이 떨어진다.

questions.passage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine decision-making authority ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. They designed their own uniforms and had authority over shifts while __________. Within two months, productivity at the plant increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
모든 제조 공정과 임금 체계는 동일하게 유지되었다
[조건] (1) all, and, manufacturing, pay, processes, same, scales, stayed, the, the를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 10단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same = 모든 제조 공정과 임금 체계는 동일하게 유지되었다
det.analysis: 본문 S3 'all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same'와 일치. 주어(all the manufacturing processes and pay scales) + 동사(stayed) + 보어(the same). 10단어.
det.tip: stay the same = 그대로/동일하게 유지되다

questions.wa: all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same
accept: all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same
